title: Prices in Part History are searchable only by users who see prices
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NOPRICE) is a staff member at {Location-A} whose custom role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NOPRICE) has 'Part Library & Inventory → View' and See Financial Data off.
  • {User-B} is signed in at {Location-A} in a second browser or a private window.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PRICE-01) is tracked at {Location-A} and its Sell Price was changed from $20.00 to $23.45, so its Part History holds a price entry.
custom_steps:
1. As the Admin open {Part-A}'s Part History and search "23.45".
  2. As {User-B} open {Part-A}'s Part History and search "23.45".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The price entry is listed.
  • Step 2: No entry is found by the price.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
